relations.subject: Charles Edmund Godakumbura
relations.evidence: In the later years, he continued his studies Kingswood College in Kandy.

relations.subject: Charles Edmund Godakumbura
relations.evidence: Concurrently, he attended classes at Sangaraja Pirivena, Kandy where he studied Pali and Sanskrit.

relations.subject: Charles Edmund Godakumbura
relations.evidence: In 1934, he completed his BA (General) examination at the University of London in Sinhalese, Pali and Sanskrit.

relations.subject: Charles Edmund Godakumbura
relations.evidence: In 1936, he passed the BA (Hons) examination in Indo-Aryan Studies.

relations.subject: Charles Edmund Godakumbura
relations.evidence: In 1938, he was awarded the MA in Indo-Aryan Studies.

relations.subject: Charles Edmund Godakumbura
relations.evidence: In 1945 he was awarded a Ph.D. from the University of London for his thesis on Sinhalese Syntax.

relations.subject: Charles Edmund Godakumbura
relations.evidence: In 1954 he was awarded a D.Litt. from the University of London for his work in Pali, Sanskrit and Sinhala.

relations.subject: Charles Edmund Godakumbura
relations.evidence: After getting through the Cambridge Senior, he joined the tutorial staff of Kingswood College.

relations.subject: Charles Edmund Godakumbura
relations.evidence: He later joined Nalanda College, Colombo

relations.subject: Charles Edmund Godakumbura
relations.role: visiting lecturer in the Department of Oriental Studies
relations.evidence: while also working as a visiting lecturer in the Department of Oriental Studies of the University College, Colombo.

relations.subject: Charles Edmund Godakumbura
relations.object: School of Oriental and African Studies of the University of London
relations.evidence: He was recalled to continue teaching at the School of Oriental and African Studies of the University of London taking an absence of leave from government service. This ended in 1959

relations.subject: Charles Edmund Godakumbura
relations.evidence: he joined the Department of Archaeology in the early 1950s as the deputy Commissioner when Professor (then Dr) Senarath Paranavithana was the Commissioner.

relations.subject: Charles Edmund Godakumbura
relations.evidence: Doctor Charles Edmund Godakumbura (5 December 1907 – 7 February 1977) was the Commissioner of Archaeology in Ceylon (Sri Lanka) from 1956 to 1967.

relations.subject: Charles Edmund Godakumbura
relations.evidence: He was confirmed as the Commissioner when Paranavithana retired in 1956, although he was still in England.

relations.subject: Charles Edmund Godakumbura
relations.object: Sri Lanka branch of the Royal Asiatic Society
relations.evidence: After retiring from the Archaeological Department Godakumbura served as the President of the Sri Lanka branch of the Royal Asiatic Society until 1970.
